format: Each test case below is implemented as a Playwright spec. The 'actual' and 'status' fields are populated at runtime; this catalog documents the designed matrix and expected behavior. Severity is assigned only when a failure is observed, with a written justification.

cases.title: Every public route loads without 404
cases.expected: All static + dynamic routes return 200 and render content

cases.title: Navbar links navigate to correct route
cases.expected: Each nav link updates the URL and renders the target page heading

cases.title: Back/forward browser navigation preserves state
cases.expected: History navigation does not blank the page

cases.title: Unknown route shows PageNotFound
cases.expected: /no-such-route renders the 404 shell, not a blank page

cases.title: Tracker route redirects unauthenticated users to /login
Intro step renders Begin control
cases.expected: Begin button is visible and enabled

cases.title: Submit disabled when no symptom selected
cases.expected: See overlap button is disabled until >=1 selection

cases.title: Results show ranked overlapping conditions
cases.expected: At least one condition card with overlap bar appears

cases.title: No duplicate conditions in results
cases.expected: Each condition slug appears at most once

cases.title: Clear all resets selections
cases.expected: Selection count returns to 0 and submit disables

cases.title: Start over resets to intro
cases.expected: Step returns to 0 and selections cleared

cases.title: All symptoms selected yields results
cases.expected: Multiple condition cards render without error

cases.title: Repeated submit clicks do not duplicate results
cases.expected: Result list length stable across rapid clicks

cases.title: Reload mid-workflow resets to intro
cases.expected: After reload, step is 0 and no stale results

cases.title: Create entry persists in localStorage
cases.expected: Entry appears in timeline after save

cases.title: Future date entry handled
cases.expected: No crash; entry stored or rejected gracefully

cases.title: Every condition page renders all sections
Related condition links navigate
cases.expected: Clicking a related card navigates to that condition

cases.title: Back to all conditions link works
Search invalid term shows empty state
Special characters do not crash search
Evidence legend renders four statuses
cases.expected: Established, Supported, Developing, Insufficient all visible

cases.title: Home page has no critical axe violations
Symptom Checker keyboard reachable
cases.expected: Tab reaches Begin and symptom cards

cases.title: Condition pages have logical heading order
10 repeated symptom checker cycles stable
cases.expected: All 10 cycles pass with no state corruption

cases.title: 20 repeated navigations stable
cases.expected: No blank pages or console errors

cases.title: Blocked API shows graceful state
cases.expected: No silent blank page on request failure
